full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Emdadul Haque Azad, J.:- Rule was issued calling upon the opposite parties to show cause as to why the Judgment and Decree dated 22.11.2010 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, 7th Court, Dhaka in Family Appeal No.88 of 2009 affirming those order dated 12.08.2009 passed by the learned Assistant Judge, 13th Court and Family Court, Dhaka in Family Suit No.109 of 2009 should not be set aside and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 5. Against the said judgment and order dated 12.08.2009 the plaintiff preferred Family Appeal No.88 of 2009 before the learned District Judge, Dhaka and on transferred the said appeal was heard and disposed of by the learned Additional District Judge, 7th Court, Dhaka who by his judgment and decree dated 22.11.2010 was pleased to dismiss the appeal and affirmed the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court. 

 "Family Court has got every jurisdiction to decide as to whether the `kabinnama' in question whether any marriage between the petitioner and opposite party was ever solemnized or not before it decides to grant any decree for dower and/or maintenance." 

 15. The impugned Judgment and Decree dated 22.11.2010 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, 7th Court, Dhaka in Family Appeal No.88 of 2009 affirming those order dated 12.08.2009 passed by the learned Assistant Judge, 13th Court and Family Court, Dhaka in Family Suit No.109 of 2009 is hereby set aside.
